chapter.verse: Hih thute khempeuh a gen khit ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah,
“Ni nih khit ciangin Paisan Pawi hong tung ding cih na thei uh hi. Tua sungin mite in Mihing' Tapa khailum nuamin lehhek ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Caiaphas a kici siampi lianpenpa' innpi ah siampi liante leh Jew makaite kikaikhawm uh a,
Jesu a simthamin mat ding leh thah ding vai geel uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in, “Jew mite sungah lungsona hong piangkha leh pawi hun sung sawm kei ni,” kici uh hi.
Bethany khua, vun natna vei Simon' inn ah Jesu a om laitak,
nilhthau a manpha mahmah kikoihna alabaster suangngo thawl khat tawi-in numei khat hong pai a, sabuai gei-a tu Jesu' lu tungah a nilhthau bungsuk hi.
Nungzuite in a muh ciangin heh uh a, “Bang hangin thangzat na hi hiam?
Hih pen sum tampi tawh zuakin mizawngte piak-huaizaw hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin hih thu Jesu in phawk ahih manin hih bangin ci hi: “Bang hangin hih numei nawngkaisak na hi uh hiam? Amah in kei' tungah nahoih khat hong sem khinzo hi.
A hang pen note' kiangah mizawngte a om den hi a, ahi zongin nomau' kiangah a om den ding ka hikei hi.
Numeinu in ka pumpi hih nilhthau hong buah pen ka luang a kivui nading kei hong puahkhol ahi hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah hih Lungdamna Thu a kitangkona leitung mun citeng ah numeinu' sepkhiat thu zong amah phawkna-in kigen ding hi.”
Tua ciangin sawmlenihte laka kihel, Judas Iscariot a kici mipa, siampi liante' kiangah va pai-in,
“Note' kiangah amah hong ap le-ing bang nong pia ding uh hiam?” a cih ciangin amau zong ngun sumtang sawmthum pia uh hi.
Tua hun-a kipan Judas in Jesu a lehhek theih nading hunpha khat zon kipan hi.
Silngo Sawhloh Anlum Pawi ni masani-in Jesu' kiangah nungzuite hong pai uh a, “Paisan Pawi an nek theih nadingin koi ah kong bawlsak ding uh deih na hi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in, “Khuasung va pai unla, mi khat' kiangah, ‘Syapa in, "Ka hun nai ta hi. Na inn ah ka nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi ka zang ding hi," ci hi,’ va ci un,” ci hi.
Nungzuite in zong Jesu' vaikhak bangin hih uh a, Paisan Pawi an bawl uh hi.
Nitak ciangin sawmlenihte tawh sabuai ah Jesu tu hi.
An a nek kawmun Jesu in, “Maantak kong cihin ah note lakah khat in kei hong lehhek ding hi,” ci hi.
Nungzuite zong dah mahmah uh ahih manin Jesu' kiangah, “Topa aw, kei ka hi hiam?” ci-in khatkhit khat dong uh hi.
Jesu in, “Kei tawh mehkuang a sawkkhawmpa in kei hong lehhek ding hi.
Mihing' Tapa pen Ama' thu a kigelh bangin a pai ding hi a, ahi zongin Mihing' Tapa a lehhek mipa ahihleh a dahhuaizia! Tua mipa, mihingin a piang ngeilo hileh ama' ading hoihzaw lai hi,” ci hi.
Jesu a lehhek dingpa Judas in, “Rabbi aw, kei ka hi hiam?” a cih ciangin Jesu in, “Ahi bangin na gen khin hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
An a nek laitakun Jesu in anlum la-in hehpihna a phat khit ciangin anlum balnenin nungzuite pia a, “La unla ne un; hih pen keima' pumpi hi,” ci hi.
Hai zong la-in hehpih a phat khit ciangin amaute pia a, hih bangin ci hi: “Na vekun hih sunga dawn un;
Hih pen mawhmaisak nadingin mi tampite' adinga a luangkhia, keima' thuciamna sisan ahi hi.
Note kong cihin ah tu-a kipan ka Pa' kumpigam sungah note tawh ka dawn thak ni mateng hih lenggui pana piang ka dawnkik nawn kei ding hi.”
Tua ciangin biakpiak la dawng khat sa uh a, Olive Mual zuanin paikhia uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in nungzuite' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: “Tu zan ciangin keima' hangin na vekun na puk ding uh hi. A hang pen hih bangin na kigelh hi: ‘Tuucingpa ka satlum ding a, tuuhonte kithehthang ding hi.’
Ahih hangin kei hong kithawhkiksak khit ciangin note' ma-in Galilee ka na pai ding hi.”
Peter in, “Nangma' hangin amau teng khempeuh a puk zongin kei ka puk ngeikei ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Maantak kong cihin ah tu zan sung mah, ak khuan ma-in thumvei nong nial ding hi,” ci hi.
Peter in, “Nang tawh ka sihkhop ding a kul leh zong kong nial kei ding hi,” ci hi. Nungzui dang khempeuh in zong tua bang mah ci ciat uh hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite tawh Gethsemane a kici mun khat ah Jesu pai-in amaute' kiangah, “Pam lamah thungenin ka va pai sung hih takah na tu un,” ci hi.
Peter leh Zebedee' tapa nihte tonpih a, dah leh lunggim kipan hi.
Amaute' kiangah, “Si ding zahin ka nunna kha nakpi-in dah hi. Hih takah na om unla pilvang navaktak hong ngak un,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin a gamlazaw deuh ah pai-in leilak ah a lu ngasukin thungen a, “Ka Pa aw, ahihtheih ding leh hih hai in kei hong kheng ta hen; ahi zongin kei' deih bang hilo-in nang' deih bang hita hen,” ci hi.
Nungzuite' kiang a tun ciangin amaute na ihmu uh hi. Tua ciangin Peter' kiangah, “Nai khat sung beek navaktak hong ngak zolo na hi uh hiam?
Navak unla siatzolnae sungah na pukkhak loh nadingun thungen un. Kha a thalawp hangin cilesa pumpi thanem hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nihveina paikhia leuleu a, “Ka Pa aw, hih hai ka dawn lohin hong kheng theilo ding ahihleh nang' deihna bang hita hen,” ci-in thungen hi.
Nungzuite' kiang a tunkik ciangin amaute ihmutsuah ki-ip zolo-in na ihmu uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute hici koihin paikhiakik a, a thumveina thungenin a ngetsa teng mah pulak hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite kiangah pai-in, “Note ihmumu-in tawlnganga lai na hi uh hiam? En un, hunlenai cing ta hi. Mawhneite' khut sungah Mihing' Tapa kilehhek ta hi.
Tho un, pai ta ni. En un, kei hong lehhekpa hong tung ta hi,” ci hi.
Tua bangin Jesu a pau laitak mah, sawmlenih laka kihel Judas hong tung hi. Siampi liante leh Jew makaite' sawl, namsau leh molhtum a tawi mihonpi zong hong tonpih hi.
(Milehhekpa in mihonpi' kiangah, “Ka nap mipa, amah hi. Tua pa man un,” ci-in theihsakna lim a na piaksa ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin Judas in Jesu' kiang zuan pah a, “Rabbi aw, na dam hiam?” ci-in nam hi.
Jesu in, “Lawm aw, bang vai-a hong pai na hi hiam?” ci hi. Tua ciangin mihonpi hong pai-in Jesu lencipin man uh hi.
Tua lianleh en un, Jesu tawh a omte lakah khat in a khut zankhia-in a namsau dok a, siampi lianpenpa' silapa a sat leh tua pa' bil kiakhia hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Na namsau a paai ah siatkik in. A hang pen namsau a tawite khempeuh namsau mah tawh si ding uh hi.
Ka Pa' kiang a kun theilo ding hong sa na hi hiam? Kun le-ing tu mahmahin vanmi galkap legion sawmlenih sanga tamzaw hong puak pah ding hi.
Ahi zongin tuaci hih le-ing hih thu piang ding a ci Pasian' Laibupi bangci tangtun theih ding ahi hiam?”

Tua hunlenai mahin Jesu in mihonpi' kiangah, “Kei hong man dinga theih, guta buluh man ding bangin namsau leh molhtum tawh hong kuankhia tazen na hi uh hiam? Nisim mahin biakinnpi ah tu-in thu ka hilhcian a, nong man kei uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian' Laibupi sunga kamsangte' thugente a tangtun nadingin hih thu khempeuh a piang ahi hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin nungzuite a vekun Jesu nusia-in taimang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu a mante in siampi lianpenpa Caiaphas' kiangah Jesu paipih uh a, tua lai-ah laisiamte leh Jew makaite na kikaikhawm khin uh hi.
Peter in a galkhat pan siampi lianpenpa' zum inntual ciangdong Jesu zui a, thupiang nunung a theih nadingin zum nasemte lakah va tu hi.
Siampi liante leh Sanhedrin bup in Jesu a thah theih nadingun ama' langkhat ah zuau teci ding zongzong uh hi.
Zuau teci a pang mi tampi hong pai hangin thu kician bangmah mukhia tuanlo uh hi. A tawpna ah mi nih hong pai-in,
“Hih mipa in, ‘Pasian' biakinnpi phelkhia-in ni thum sungin ka lamkik zo ding hi,’ ci hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa dingto-in Jesu' kiangah, “Dawng theilo na hi hiam? Nang' langkhat ah hih mite' teci panna bangci dan ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu pau lo-in om hi. Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa in, “A nungta Pasian' min tawh nang kong sawl hi. Pasian' Tapa, Khris na hihleh kote hong gen in,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Ahi bangin na gen khin hi. Ahih hangin ke'n kong cihin ah Vanglianpa' taklam ah a tu, vantung meiilom tung tuanga hong pai Mihing' Tapa na mu ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa in a puantual balkekin, “Hih pa, Pasian daisakna kam pau khinzo hi. Teci dang bang kisam nawn i hi hiam? Tu-in Pasian a daisakna kam na za khinta uh hi.
Bangci na sa uh hiam?” ci hi. Ulian makaite in, “Sihna a tuah ding kilawm hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu' maitang cilphih uh a, khuttum tawh tum uh hi. Kimkhat in paangbet uh a,
“Nang Khris aw, kamsanna tawh hong gen dih in. Tu-a hong beeng kua ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tu-in Peter pen siampi lianpenpa' zum a pualam, zum inntual ah a tut laitak, sawltangzang numei khat ama' kiangah hong pai-in, “Nang zong Galilee mi Jesu tawh na kikhawl hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua mite khempeuh' mai-ah Peter in nial a, “Na thugen ka thei kei hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin huang kongpi lam Peter a paikhiat laitak sawltangzang numei dang khat in amah mu-in a gei-a omte' kiangah, “Hih mipa Nazareth khuami Jesu tawh kikhawl hi,” ci leuleu hi.
Peter in zong nial leuleu a, “Tua mipa ka thei kei hi,” ci-in kiciam hi.
A den deuh ciangin a gei-a om khat hong pai-in Peter' kiangah, “Nang zong hua mite khat na hi taktak hi. Na kampauzia tawh kithei hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin haamsiat kam zangin Peter kiciam a, “Tua mipa ka thei kei hi,” ci hi. Tua khit phetin ak khuang hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in Jesu' genkholh thu, “Ak khuan ma-in thumvei nong nial ding hi” a cih phawkkik ahih manin paikhia-in nakpitak kap hi.
